about: Willo's actions: the one list of what her answers may do for the player in her apps, and how each is confirmed (LOR-844 step 6).
The site reads it here (lib/willo-tools.js); the PC app reads its copy, companion/lore_companion/actions.json, which scripts/rebuild-generated.sh writes and scripts/check.sh keeps current.
side: site is a tool the site does itself (a message to a friend): no app lists or runs it, and its tier is how the site confirms it.

Contract: an app lists the actions it can run in X-LF-Capabilities, space-separated. The token actions/1 says the list is complete; then a flat tool is listed by its id (set_voice) and a grouped tool's operation as tool.op (talk.off). An app without actions/1 (a PC older than this) gets only the legacy tools, as before. The iPhone sends actions/1 alone.

An action goes to the app as {id, args, label, now?}: a grouped tool's operation is args.op. now: true means the player plainly asked for it, so it runs at once; the app honors it only for the tiers whose now is true here, and treats anything else as an offer.

args: {list} is one of lists below, or a list the asking app's state gives: voices (the plan's voices), talk_keys (the keys she hears, lib/willo-tools.js TALK_KEYS) and chats (the titles of their past chats, in the PC's state lines); {text: n} is the player's words, at most n letters (optional: the site fills it in when the model gives none); {site: …} the site fills in after her call, never the model (memories: the ids of the memories her words name; character: the asking character's Name-Realm). The app checks every argument again.

needs: an operation that only makes sense in a moment the asking app's state shows (reminder_showing: its "reminder showing now" line; update_ready: its version line says one is ready; player: the Lore Player is playing or paused) is declared only then.

pick: {section, ask} on a value that's the player's to choose (her voice, her color, their talk key): the site runs the change only with one they named, or the voice before on "switch back", matched loosely against the list ("fell green" is fel); with none, it opens that card of her Settings and asks which, never picking one for them (LOR-856 A4).

done: what she says once an operation done at once has run (now), with each {argument} as the player hears it, or a line for each value of its argument: the site's words for it, never hers, so she never names a voice or a count it didn't set (LOR-856 A3). The app's own line under the answer says what it really did.
Nothing here acts inside WoW, and money is never by voice.

show.what: opens or shows something in her window and changes nothing

do.what: harmless and done at once, with nothing to undo: say it again, look again, check for an update, snooze a reminder

undo.what: a change that can be put back: runs at once when asked plainly, else a tap or a spoken yes; always with Undo

yes.what: read back to the player first, then a tap or a spoken yes (an action's own undo: true gives it Undo after)

send.what: fills in a note the player sends themselves

preview.what: a screenshot shown to the player first; Send or a yes after it is shown, Undo while unread

consent.what: shows the same explanation as its Settings card; only the player's click on Turn on under it turns it on

money.what: a tap in her window only: opens the page, never buys, never shown over the game

wisp.label: Show my settings over the game

live.label: How to turn it on in the game

remarks.label: Show how often I chime in

open_settings.what: opens a card in her Settings

open_plans.what: opens the Plans page in the browser, signed in; never buys

open_billing.what: opens Billing in the browser, signed in

open_keeps.what: opens What Willo keeps in the browser, signed in: everything she keeps, to change or erase

message_friend.what: a message to one of their friends, in their words, read back before their yes (done on the site: lib/friend-send.js)

set_style.what: how she talks to them, one of her styles or their own words on a plan with them, done when they plainly ask; back by asking again or on Her ways (done on the site: lib/willo-custom.js)

keeps.what: What Willo keeps: Help improve answers off at once; a kind of kept thing, or everything and her chats, read back with its count and erased on a plain yes (done on the site: lib/willo-keeps.js)

send_feedback.what: fills in "Something's wrong" with a note; the player presses Send

set_voice.what: switches her voice to one the player's plan has; "switch back" or "the other one" is the voice your state names as voice before

new_chat.what: starts a new chat; the old one stays in the list, and Undo reopens it

set_talk_key.what: sets her talk key to one she can hear; then /reload in the game

capture_game_to_friend.what: prepares a local game screenshot for a named friend; the player reviews it and chooses Send before upload

live_game_info.what: Live game info, turned on by the player's click under its explanation

see_the_game.what: seeing the game when they ask (Hero and up), turned on by the player's click under its explanation

talk.what: how you talk and listen in your own app. Never the game's keybinds, chat or voice chat

on.label: Turn talking on
on.what: turn talking with you on (it uses the microphone while the talk key is held)

off.label: Turn talking off
off.what: turn talking with you off: no listening, and you answer in writing
off.done: Talking's off: I'll answer in writing.

pick.ask: Which key would you like to hold? Pick it here.

key.label: Use {key}
key.what: move your talk key, the key they hold to talk to you; never a key for a spell, an item or the game (then /reload in the game)

pick.ask: Which voice would you like? Here are mine.

voice.label: Switch to {voice}
voice.what: switch your voice to another of their plan's voices: yours, or one of Azeroth's peoples (dwarf-male)

engine.label: Speak with {engine}
engine.what: how you speak: hosted (your full voice), local (the voice on their computer) or captions (words only, never out loud); never a voice by its name

remarks.what: only when they talk about you: how often you chime in on your own while they play, and the little sound you make when you do (your chirps). Never the game's sounds, music or chat, the Lore Player's story, birds or anyone else

level.label: Remarks: {level}
level.what: how often you chime in on your own: often, sometimes, rarely or off

done.sometimes: I'll chime in now and then.

look.what: your own color and your wisp over the game. Never the game's interface

pick.ask: Which color would you like? Here are mine.

color.label: Make me {color}
color.what: your color: a swatch, or any color as #rrggbb

wisp_show.label: Show the wisp
wisp_show.what: show your wisp over the game
wisp_show.done: Here I am, over the game.

wisp_hide.label: Hide the wisp
wisp_hide.what: hide your wisp over the game

show.label: Show me
show.what: bring your wisp up now, only when they can't find you or ask you to come out

home.label: Put me back
home.what: put your wisp back in its usual place

target.what: your keys for talking to the one they target, and to you outside the game. Never the game's keybinds

key.label: Use {key} for your target
key.what: the key they hold so the one they target answers; never a key for a spell, an item or the game (then /reload in the game)

key_off.label: No target key
key_off.what: no key for talking to the one they target

shortcut.label: Use {chord} outside the game
shortcut.what: turn on your own shortcut that talks to you outside the game, with that chord; never a keybind for the game

shortcut_off.label: Turn the shortcut off
shortcut_off.what: turn your shortcut outside the game off

player.what: the Lore Player in your window: only the Lore Forever story your state says is playing or paused. Never the game's music, sounds, songs, quests, cutscenes or travel

play.label: Play
play.what: carry on with the paused story

back.label: Back 15 seconds
back.what: go back 15 seconds in the story (never going back to a place)

forward.label: Skip 15 seconds
forward.what: skip ahead 15 seconds in the story

again.label: From the start
again.what: play the story from the start

volume.label: Volume {level}
volume.what: the story's volume: quieter, louder, or a percent

chats.what: their past chats with you, by the titles your state lists. Never the game's chat, channels, whispers or mail

list.label: Your chats
list.what: show the list of their past chats, when they ask to see, list or find their chats (name the newest few from your state as you do)

open.label: Open {chat}
open.what: open one of their past chats, by its title

delete.label: Delete {chat}
delete.what: delete one past chat, after reading its title back

settings.what: your own Settings in your app, only when they ask to see or open one of yours. Never the game's options, keybinds, sound, interface or windows

open.label: {section}
open.what: open a card or group in your Settings

health.what: whether you and the game work together

rescan.label: Look again
rescan.what: look at the game's files again now (after they changed something in the game)

check.label: Check for an update
check.what: check for a newer version of you now

restart.label: Restart to update
restart.what: restart you to finish an update that's ready

snooze.label: Snooze 1 hour
snooze.what: remind them again in an hour about the reminder you're showing
snooze.done: I'll remind you again in an hour.

memory.what: what you keep in mind about the player themselves, when they plainly ask: who they are, what to call them, how, when and with whom they play, what they like (to-dos, reminders, goals and places are their notebook's). Say it as a friend would: "I'll keep that in mind."

remember.label: Remember: {text}
remember.what: one lasting thing about themselves (text: in their words, without "remember that")

forget.label: Forget: {text}
forget.what: let go of something they told you about themselves (text: their words for it)

forget_all.label: Forget everything
forget_all.what: let go of all of it, read back first

list.label: What I remember
list.what: show what you keep in mind about them
